cards.headline: NVT moving on no clear catalyst

cards.headline: Risk: AI bubble index 56 — Heating Up
cards.body: The composite AI Bubble Index sits at 56/100, led by Valuation at 83. Higher = frothier; the risk is everyone caring at once while valuations are already stretched.
